subject: Request: Covantix promo extension + combined credits authorization
messages:
From: Maya Lerner <maya.lerner@covantix.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reddick <tom.reddick@covantix.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Need help: promo extension + credits to finish POC

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers. We have one practical constraint: our procurement cycle slipped and our internal approval for the main PO won't clear until mid-June. That means our POC will run out of the promotional credits you granted on May 20 if we don’t extend.

Ask: can Redwood extend the promo credits by 4 weeks and add a small one-time credit top-up (equivalent to $6k) so we can finish integration tests and an external evaluation? If you need, I can get a short note from our CTO confirming timeline.

Attachments: Covantix_initial_requirements.pdf (pdf stub)

Appreciate any help — Tom and I are aligned on next steps.

Best,
Maya Lerner
Head of Platform
Covantix

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Need help: promo extension + credits to finish POC

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding Covantix ask. Short summary:
- Request: 4-week extension + one-time $6k credit (they’re in mid-POC, procurement delayed)
- ARR potential: estimated $420k over 12 months if pilot converts (we have usage telemetry and enterprise signals)
- Risk: small concession on hosted credits vs setting precedent

Marissa, can you run a quick pricing calc and recommend an approval path? If you think this needs exec sign-off, Aditya — can you weigh in on whether we can authorize on your level or if we should route to MGR leadership?

I’m happy to jump on a quick call with Covantix if that helps.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior AE | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 12:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Need help: promo extension + credits to finish POC

Thanks for the forward, Jonas. I ran the numbers (see attached worksheet). Key points:
- Recommended concession: extend promo credits by 4 weeks AND apply a one-time credit of $6,000 (net effective cost to Redwood estimated at ~$4,200 after utilization profile).
- Condition: Credits applied only to the Covantix production namespace for this POC; must sign updated SOW and a 30-day committed evaluation clause (simple DocuSign).
- Upside: close to 90% likelihood of conversion to paid pilot leading to expansion opportunity.

I think this qualifies as an exception that requires your approval, Aditya, because it exceeds the standard SDR-level promo top-up. If approved, legal should issue an updated SOW and finance will log a concession for bookkeeping.

Attachments: covantix_pricing_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Marissa
Sr. Mgr, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Finance Team <finance@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Need help: promo extension + credits to finish POC

Appreciate the analysis. I approve the following on an exception basis:
1) Extend the existing promotional credits for Covantix by 4 weeks from current expiry date.
2) Apply a one-time $4,000 credit now and authorize a second contingent $2,000 credit to be released only if Covantix signs the updated SOW within 30 days post-extension.

Conditions/ops:
- Legal must prepare an updated SOW with the 30-day signature clause and specific namespace allocation (no cross-account transfer).
- Finance to record this as a sales concession under deal CVX-2028-0417 and update ARR forecasting accordingly.
- Marissa, please confirm the credit ledger entry and confirm how reconciliation will be handled if they don’t sign within the contingency window.

Jonas: you can communicate the approved terms to Covantix. Keep the conversation tight and confirm procurement contact will sign the SOW within the window — we don’t want open-ended credits.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Lerner <maya.lerner@covantix.ai>, Tom Reddick <tom.reddick@covantix.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@covantix.ai
Date: Thu, 18 May 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need help: promo extension + credits to finish POC

Maya / Tom — good news: we can make this work with the following approved exception:
- We will extend your promotional credits by 4 weeks from current expiry.
- We’re applying a $4,000 credit today. We’ll hold an additional $2,000 contingent credit which will be released once the updated SOW is signed within 30 days after the extension ends.

Next steps (action items):
1) Procurement (procurement@covantix.ai) to review and sign the updated SOW once Legal sends the DocuSign (expected within 24 business hours).
2) Covantix to confirm the namespace to allocate credits to (please reply with the primary project ID).
3) Marissa/Legal/Finance will onboard the concession in our systems and send the signed record to Covantix (Jonas to confirm upon signature).

Attachments sent after approval: approved_exception_signed.pdf (signed internal approval stub) and an updated SOW to follow from Legal.

Thanks for moving quickly on this. Happy to hop on a call if you want to review the conditional credit release.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
